claim: A sample outside the map ROI is not automatically invalid for model fitting, but usefulness depends on membership in the same target population, compatible sample support and covariate-space area of applicability; convenience relocation is not independent probability validation.
conditions: Applies to actual samples moved from planned locations because of access constraints, including the 22 current locations outside ROI.
limitations: AOA is a model- and covariate-dependent diagnostic and does not prove causal similarity or remove sampling bias.
recommended_action: Retain the actual coordinates, compute planned-to-actual distance and relocation reason when available, check covariate dissimilarity/AOA, fit with and without questionable points as sensitivity analysis, and mask final maps to ROI.
not_allowed_action: Do not discard points solely because they cross the ROI boundary, and do not call convenience-relocated points an independent validation set.
